bounds: One canonical client and one installed-client alias; boolean presence, enabled state, exact binding equality and chained-alias state.
limitations: Exact binding equality includes the app UUID, callback, enabled flag and credential lifetime. Existing parser regression cases exercise each mismatch separately.

Grant acknowledgement, key expiry and account/organization authority are still enforced by the unchanged owner-credential path and modeled separately. This model does not authorize a database or registry mutation.

Recovery requires an operator-provided matching alias and a new read; there is no unconditional liveness claim while configuration keeps changing. Live deployment and retained-token acceptance need separate evidence.
